test_title: RRB Group D Official Paper (Held On: 09 Dec, 2025 Shift 2)
subject: general
question:
Read the given statements and conclusions carefully. Assuming that the information given in the statements is true, even if it appears to be at variance with commonly known facts, decide which of the given conclusion(s) logically follow(s) from the statement(s).

**Statements:**

All jams are cobras.

All cobras are mats.

**Conclusions:**

(I) Some mats are cobras.

(II) All jams are mats.
solution:
The least possible Venn diagram for the given statements is as shown below :

 [IMAGE: https://cdn.repeatermock.com/tb/3f729724cc6d6ff43033785ac22e39097a30910291085ecdc818ef8b62e0f3b7.png] 

Conclusions:

(I) Some mats are cobras → Follow (As all cobras are mats. As whole cobras comes in mats, therefore it is true.)

(II) All jams are mats → Follow (As all jams are cobras and all cobras are mats. As whole jams comes in cobras which whole comes in mats, therefore it is true.)

∴ Here, Both conclusions (I) and (II) follow.​

Hence, the correct answer is "Option 3".
